name: Kacper Lewandowski
bio:
Kacper Lewandowski's ascent in motorsport has been meteoric. From a young age, he was immersed in the world of racing thanks to his father, a former rally driver. While most kids played video games, Kacper was dissecting telemetry data and tinkering with engines in his father's garage.

His analytical mind and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly set him apart. He skipped the lower rungs of the racing ladder, diving straight into team management after completing a degree in mechanical engineering. Kacper is known for his data-driven approach, demanding the highest standards from his team. He believes a team's success hinges on meticulous preparation, cutting-edge technology, and an unwavering commitment to excellence.

Despite his young age, Lewandowski's reputation precedes him. He's a brilliant strategist, unafraid to make bold decisions, and possesses an uncanny ability to identify and nurture talent. He is driven by the belief that constant improvement is the only path to sustained success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Kacper has a sharp, focused look with a determined set to his jaw.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in meetings.
Has a specific brand of coffee he insists on having every morning.
Obsessively cleans his desk multiple times a day.
